title: This Fake Guru Teaches You How to Go Broke
summary: Debunk of a self-styled professional gambler selling a Martingale variant: house edge and table limits guarantee eventual bankruptcy.

assertions.quote: no one has an unlimited bankroll and the casinos put in table betting limits

verdicts.note: Martingale ruin under a finite bankroll and bet limits is a textbook result.

assertions.quote: In roulette the casino always holds an edge on every gamble
a six game losing streak happens every 64 hands, and a seven game losing streak happens every 128 hands on average

verdicts.note: Follows directly from independent near-even bets.

verdicts.note: For MLM companies' own income disclosures, none of the 70 nets out all expenses and most say so only in fine print under unqualified 'earnings' headings; this is company disclosures rather than guru screenshots, but the same gross-not-net pattern.

Empire touted gross sales figures ('$50k in sales', '$200k in one month') while, per the FTC, clients with gross sales still lost significant sums after subtracting fees, Amazon fees, inventory, refunds, loan interest and operating costs; nothing on edited screenshots.
